mechanics.coreLoop: Equip the Sunbrand Unique Flail, apply Judgement with Holy Bolt and Holy Light Aura, detonate Judgement with Blessed Hammer to feed cooldown support, then cast Heaven's Fury as a flail-powered orbiting light sprinkler.

coreInteractions.name: Sunbrand flail sprinkler
coreInteractions.summary: Sunbrand is a Paladin Unique Flail that gives Heaven's Fury 3 additional rays and a 70-90% increased damage roll.
coreInteractions.scalingModel: More Heaven's Fury ray events plus a large additive/increased damage range on the same payoff skill.

refs.name: Sunbrand
refs.notes: Local database lists Sunbrand as a Paladin Unique Flail.

coreInteractions.notes: The meme is literal: the required weapon is a flail, and the payoff is spinning rays.

coreInteractions.name: Walk With The Light ray pile
coreInteractions.summary: The Heaven's Fury upgrade Walk With The Light splits the skill into 5 orbiting beams for 7 seconds; Sunbrand should add rays to that beam plan, but exact final ray behavior needs client verification.
coreInteractions.scalingModel: Five orbiting beams from the skill-tree upgrade, plus Sunbrand's additional rays if the effects stack directly.
coreInteractions.notes: Treat the 8-ray version as the build hypothesis, not a confirmed client fact.

coreInteractions.name: Judgement cooldown laundering
coreInteractions.summary: Judicator Oath lets Basic Skills apply Judgement and Judicator Core Skills consume it; Aspect of Contemplation then turns consumed Judgement into active cooldown reduction.
coreInteractions.scalingModel: Holy Bolt applies Judgement, Blessed Hammer consumes it, and repeated consumptions reduce active cooldowns while also enabling Judgement damage scaling.
coreInteractions.notes: Local specialization wording notes that public guide wording may lag Season 14 patch changes, so the Oath behavior is marked likely at the full-engine level.

coreInteractions.name: Aura and rune recast grease
coreInteractions.summary: Resplendence, Zan/Zec, cooldown affixes, and resource tempers are layered to make the 30-second Heaven's Fury cooldown less humiliating.
coreInteractions.scalingModel: Aura casts reduce non-Aura cooldowns, Ultimate casts generate Offering for Ultimate cooldown reduction, and gear adds flat cooldown reduction from the current affix pool.

guide.overview: Flail Mary is a Paladin prototype that equips Sunbrand, a Unique Flail, and turns Heaven's Fury into the main payoff. Holy Bolt and Holy Light Aura apply Judgement, Blessed Hammer consumes it to keep cooldowns moving, and the final screen goal is simple: walk around while orbiting Heaven's Fury rays make the room look like a bad safety inspection.

rotation.summary: Judge, hammer, aura, then let the Sunbrand beams do the embarrassing part.
opener: Enter a pack with Holy Bolt to apply Judgement and activate Aspect of Might if equipped.
Cast Holy Light Aura with Rite of Judgement to spread more Judgement and start the aura cooldown package.
Spend Blessed Hammer into Judged enemies to consume Judgement and trigger Aspect of Contemplation.
Cast Heaven's Fury when elites are grouped, then move through the pack so Walk With The Light beams overlap targets.
Use Defiance Aura before crowd control or burst damage; use Rally when Faith or movement drops.
sequence: Holy Bolt until Judgement is present.
Blessed Hammer to consume Judgement and create chain/explosion filler damage.
Holy Light Aura on cooldown for Judgement, healing, and Resplendence-style cooldown support.
Heaven's Fury on elite packs, bosses, and objective rooms.
Defiance Aura and Rally maintain survival, movement, and Faith.
bossing: Hold Heaven's Fury until the boss is stationary or forced into a predictable lane.
Circle close enough for orbiting beams to tick without standing in avoidable mechanics.
Use Blessed Hammer between Heaven's Fury windows to keep Judgement consumption and cooldown reduction active.
If Aspect of Channeling fails client verification, swap the Amulet aspect to Aspect of Holy Punishment for boss consistency.
speedFarm: Skip isolated trash unless Heaven's Fury is already active.
Use Rally and Boots movement to drag orbiting beams through density.
Spend Holy Light Aura on packs rather than saving it for bosses; the build wants cooldown churn.
rotation.notes: Do not hard-cast Final Justice in this version; the build is built around moving orbiting beams, not a stationary delayed nuke.

strengths: High event density if Sunbrand rays and Walk With The Light stack cleanly.
Judicator loop gives the meme build a practical cooldown plan.
No mythic unique required for the core version.
weaknesses: Primary payoff is tied to an Ultimate cooldown.
Ray stacking and channel-tag assumptions require current-client verification.
Single-target can slump if orbiting beams miss or the boss moves.
Sunbrand occupies the weapon slot, limiting offensive aspect placement.

variants.name: Light's Rebuke Flail Variant
variants.summary: Swap Sunbrand for Light's Rebuke and rebuild around Divine Lance, Stacking Damage, and Tip of the Spear. Do not equip both flails at once in this guide shell.
tradeoffs: Potentially better focused boss damage if Divine Lance's subsequent-hit bonus lands consistently.
Loses the Heaven's Fury ray identity.

variants.name: No-Channeling Variant
variants.summary: If Heaven's Fury does not count as channeling, replace Aspect of Channeling with Aspect of Holy Punishment on Amulet and move the existing Holy Punishment slot to Proselytizing.
tradeoffs: Less dependence on ambiguous tag behavior.

steps.title: Build the Judicator shell before the flail drops
goals: Use Judicator Oath, Holy Bolt, Blessed Hammer, Holy Light Aura, Defiance Aura, Rally, and Heaven's Fury.
Practice the Judge then consume loop without needing Sunbrand.
actions: Select Holy Bolt Judgement and Ricocheting Bolt.
Select Blessed Hammer Cast Speed, Cost Reduction, and Shattering Blow.
Use any one-handed weapon and shield with Holy Damage, cooldown, resource, and life affixes.
Keep Heaven's Fury as the payoff even before Sunbrand so the rotation does not change later.

steps.title: Assemble the cooldown clown car
goals: Acquire cooldown aspects and Judicator support.
Make Heaven's Fury available often enough to justify building around it.
actions: Equip Aspect of Contemplation on a ring.
Use Aspect of Firm Decree, Aspect of Might, and Aspect of Shelter for the defensive floor.
Temper Worldly Stability Cooldown Reduction or Resource Generation on rings.
Add Judicator Finesse and Elemental Finesse: Day where slot rules allow.

steps.title: Turn on the flail sprinkler
goals: Equip Sunbrand and lock Heaven's Fury into Walk With The Light.
Prioritize the Sunbrand unique roll and cooldown stack.
actions: Equip Sunbrand in the Weapon slot and record the unique power roll.
Select Heaven's Fury Duration and Walk With The Light.
Use Holy Light Aura before Heaven's Fury when possible to start Judgement and cooldown support.
Run Zan/Zec if the socket plan allows a single Ultimate cooldown rune pair.

steps.title: Scale Judgement Day and aura uptime
goals: Prioritize Sentencing, Relentless, Beacon, and Endure boards.
Add Heaven's Radiant Fire charms if talisman slots permit.
Keep a mercenary or ally inside aura range for Beacon.
actions: Level Judicator, Law, Resplendence, Canny, and Undaunted glyphs in that order.
Use Heaven's Radiant Fire as the preferred Paladin charm set because its Judgement Day bonuses match the build's loop.
Masterwork cooldown first, then Holy Damage multiplier, then Maximum Life or Armor.

steps.title: Prove the joke is functional
goals: Count Heaven's Fury rays with and without Sunbrand.
Verify whether Aspect of Channeling affects Heaven's Fury.
Measure whether Judgement consumption noticeably reduces Heaven's Fury downtime.
actions: Record a short clip of Walk With The Light without Sunbrand, then with Sunbrand.
Compare Amulet Aspect of Channeling against Aspect of Holy Punishment on the same target class.
If the downtime loop fails, downgrade status from testing to blueprint and rebuild around Light's Rebuke Divine Lance.
steps.notes: No broad inventory test needed; this is a tight interaction check.

guide.notes: Mercenary note: Beacon board wants an ally or mercenary inside an Aura. Keep the mercenary near the Paladin when testing Beacon uptime.

evidence.summary: Local Seasons_Patches marks S14, Season of Death Awakening, Patch 3.1.0 Build #72592 as the current research frame.
v_unique_items lists Sunbrand as a Paladin Unique Flail; v_unique_item_scalars records Heaven's Fury gains 3 additional rays and 70-90% increased damage.
v_skill_summary and v_skill_tree_nodes list Heaven's Fury as a Paladin Judicator Ultimate and expose Duration plus Walk With The Light selections.
v_class_specializations lists Judicator Oath as Basic Skills applying Judgement and Judicator Core Skills detonating Judgement, with a local warning that public wording may lag Season 14 changes.
v_aspects contains Aspect of Contemplation, Firm Decree, Holy Punishment, Channeling, Might, Shelter, Holy Cadence, and Apogeic Furor rows used by this guide.
v_paragon_boards and v_paragon_glyphs list Paladin Sentencing, Relentless, Beacon, Endure, Judicator, Law, Resplendence, Canny, and Undaunted support.
v_temper_manuals and v_temper_affixes list Elemental Finesse: Day, Worldly Stability, Aura Innovation, Guardian Finesse, Judicator Finesse, and Natural Motion as legal support manuals.
v_rune_pairing_candidates lists Zan plus Zec as an Ultimate-loop pairing candidate, and v_talisman_charm_sets lists Heaven's Radiant Fire as a Paladin Judgement-oriented charm set.

legalityNotes.message: Use Judicator as the only Paladin Oath for this build.
Only Heaven's Fury is selected as an Ultimate skill.
Do not treat Light's Rebuke as a simultaneous equip target; it is a variant flail, not part of the Sunbrand core.
Zan/Zec is one generator rune plus one spender rune; do not reuse either rune in another pair.
Flail is present in the local item slot table, but build-guide.schema.json does not expose Flail as a gear slot enum; Sunbrand is encoded as slot Weapon with extensions.dbSlot=Flail.

notes: Evidence was drawn only from local Compendium files and the local sqlite database per the Jeff skill. No online lookup was used. The build is deliberately a meme, but its mandatory parts are locally represented and schema-valid.
